request_observation.interpretation: The request traversed BasicServiceImpl and reached StationController, but the external client timed out at 10 seconds before receiving the eventual server-side business response.

post_recovery_observation.interpretation: A read-only request after cleanup returned to the normal response contract, supporting recovery of the application path.

comparison_to_bounded_profile.bounded_profile_latency: 500ms injected delay preserved HTTP 200 and raised repeated samples to 525-532ms
comparison_to_bounded_profile.boundary_profile: 5s injected delay caused a client timeout at the 10s observation limit

defense_interpretation.what_was_defended: The downstream station handler eventually executed and the service-side code produced its normal business response.
defense_interpretation.what_was_not_defended: The upstream client had no observed fast timeout, retry budget, fallback, or circuit-breaker response before the 10-second limit.
defense_interpretation.root_cause_hypothesis: The injected latency exceeded the effective end-to-end request budget; BasicServiceImpl has no explicit timeout or local recovery branch in the inspected source.

execution_learning.lesson: kubectl apply and Chaos Mesh injection are asynchronous; a request issued before injectedCount=1 is not an effect observation.
execution_learning.required_gate: Wait for status.experiment.containerRecords[].injectedCount >= 1, then issue the request within the duration window, then wait for recoveredCount >= 1.
invalid_attempts: basic-network-delay-5s-short: request ran before controller injection and completed in 65ms
basic-network-delay-5s-gated: injection completed between tool calls and the resource expired before the next request

next_evidence: Repeat the timeout-boundary run with a client that records the eventual HTTP response separately from the client timeout.
Inspect the effective RestTemplate request factory and Spring Boot defaults in the running image.
Test repeated requests after timeout to detect thread, connection-pool, or retry amplification.
Add tracing or correlation IDs to distinguish outbound delay from response propagation delay.
